name: Cold Email Sequence
description: Generate a 5-email outbound sequence personalized to your audience and offer.

questions.question: Who are you emailing? Be specific (role, company size, industry).
What problem do they have that you solve?
What's your offer or angle? (Free audit, demo, content, etc.)
What outcome did past customers get?

steps.name: Generate 5-Email Sequence
steps.description: Write the sequence in plain text.

config.promptTemplate: Write a 5-email cold outbound sequence for the following campaign. Plain text only. No marketing-speak. Each email under 80 words. Sender: {{senderName}}, {{senderRole}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Problem: {{problemArea}}. Offer: {{offer}}. Past outcome: {{outcome}}. Use the structure: Email 1 Hook (specific personal observation), Email 2 Value (one tactic or insight), Email 3 Social Proof (two named outcomes), Email 4 Soft Ask (right-person check), Email 5 Breakup (close the loop politely). Include subject lines for each. No exclamation marks. No 'just checking in'. No 'circling back'.
config.systemPrompt: Write like a real person. Short sentences. No corporate filler.
